text: Hi, Professor. I was hoping to talk to you about the group project for your class. Of course! What’s on your mind? I’m having trouble working with one of my group members. They’re not contributing much to the project, and it’s causing a lot of stress for me and the other members. I see. Have you tried talking to your group member about this? Yes, but they don’t seem to take it seriously. Well, I can reach out to them and see if there’s anything I can do to help. In the meantime, I would suggest dividing up the work as evenly as possible and documenting everyone’s contributions. The only thing is that I don’t want them to know that it was me that complained about them. How about I keep the feedback to them general and don’t mention any names. Would that be alright? Okay, that sounds like a good idea. Thank you for your help.
